        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])

    drows=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1]

    vdiv=dcols[0]; hdiv=drows[0]

    out=[]

            # row index into block: for i<bh -> i; else i maps: rows bh..: skip divider rows
            ri=i
            # count dividers before i
            if hdiv is not None and i>bh:
                nd=(i-bh+(bh))//(bh+1)
                ri=i-nd
            row=[]

                    if vdiv is not None and j>bw:
